description: Execute a tool call through the TORK governance gateway. Reads the tool's policy from the governance registry (failing closed if the registry cannot be read), applies the decision, and — only on an allow — invokes the downstream tool and returns its real result. Every decision is written to mcp_tool_calls.

agent_id.description: ID of the agent making the call

industry.description: Industry profile to activate for specialized PII patterns

parameters.description: Parameters to pass to the tool

region.description: Regional PII profiles to activate (e.g. ['ae', 'in']). Available: au, us, gb, eu, ae, sa, ng, in, jp, cn, kr, br

tool_name.description: Name of the tool to execute

name: tork_governed_passthrough
